headline: CHAMPION'S FURY UNLEASHED

artDirection.backgroundPrompt:
The pre-styled bear warrior illustration is positioned center-left of the composition, scaled to occupy roughly 70% of the frame height while maintaining generous breathing room on the right side for text placement. The bear's flying kick pose creates a powerful diagonal energy flow from bottom-left to top-right, with explosive orange speed lines extending in sharp geometric bursts that contrast beautifully against the template's clean dark charcoal background. Electric blue motion trails flow in smooth arcs behind the bear's movement, rendered in clean vector style with subtle transparency effects that add depth without cluttering. Bright yellow energy fragments and impact sparks scatter strategically around the kick point in precise geometric shapes - triangles, diamonds, and angular shards that maintain the premium aesthetic. The bear's muscular form benefits from dramatic side lighting that creates sculptural definition against the minimalist dark backdrop, with rim highlights in white that separate the figure cleanly. Small energy wisps and atmospheric particles float in the negative space, adding kinetic energy while preserving clear zones for typography overlay. The composition balances raw athletic power with sophisticated restraint, embodying the high-stakes drama of championship combat betting.

From illustration-14: Apply the clean geometric motion techniques and minimalist background approach that lets the subject dominate. From illustration-52: Borrow the dramatic lighting effects and premium atmospheric mood with sophisticated color treatment. From illustration-53: Use the smooth gradient techniques and clean vector styling that creates luxury brand appeal with sharp, professional edges.
